parameters.query: UPDATE summary_jobs SET status='processing', started_at=COALESCE(started_at, NOW()), updated_at=NOW() WHERE id='{{$json.jobId}}';

INSERT INTO summary_results (job_id,user_id,summary_text,model,provider,input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens,latency_ms,cost_est_usd,raw_response_json,created_at)
SELECT j.id, j.user_id, '{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.summaryTextSql || ""}}', '{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.modelSql || ""}}', 'openai', {{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.inputTokens || 0}}, {{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.outputTokens || 0}}, {{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.totalTokens || 0}}, {{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.latencyMs || 0}}, {{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.costEstUsd || 0}}, '{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.rawJsonSql || "{}"}}'::jsonb, NOW()
FROM summary_jobs j
WHERE j.id='{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.jobIdSql || ""}}'
  AND '{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.ok}}'='true'
ON CONFLICT (job_id) DO UPDATE SET
  summary_text=EXCLUDED.summary_text,
  model=EXCLUDED.model,
  provider=EXCLUDED.provider,
  input_tokens=EXCLUDED.input_tokens,
  output_tokens=EXCLUDED.output_tokens,
  total_tokens=EXCLUDED.total_tokens,
  latency_ms=EXCLUDED.latency_ms,
  cost_est_usd=EXCLUDED.cost_est_usd,
  raw_response_json=EXCLUDED.raw_response_json,
  created_at=NOW();

UPDATE summary_jobs
SET status=CASE WHEN '{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.ok}}'='true' THEN 'completed' ELSE 'failed' END,
    error_message=CASE WHEN '{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.ok}}'='true' THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF('{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.errorMessageSql || "Sync workflow failed"}}',''),'Sync workflow failed') END,
    openai_request_id=CASE WHEN '{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.ok}}'='true' THEN COALESCE(openai_request_id, NULLIF('{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.openaiRequestIdSql || ""}}','')) ELSE openai_request_id END,
    completed_at=NOW(),
    updated_at=NOW()
WHERE id='{{$node["Parse Sync Outcome"].json.jobIdSql || ""}}';

WITH queued AS (
  SELECT
    j.id AS job_id,
    j.user_id,
    d.filename,
    j.created_at
  FROM summary_jobs j
  INNER JOIN documents d ON d.id = j.document_id AND d.user_id = j.user_id
  WHERE j.status='queued'
    AND j.execution_mode='batch'
    AND j.batch_strategy='{{$json.batchStrategySql}}'
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int AS queue_count
  FROM queued
)
SELECT
  q.job_id,
  q.user_id,
  q.filename,
  '{{$json.appBaseSql}}' AS app_base,
  '{{$json.expectedTokenSql}}' AS expected_token,
  '{{$json.openaiKeySql}}' AS openai_key,
  '{{$json.openaiModelSql}}' AS openai_model,
  '{{$json.completionWindowSql}}' AS completion_window,
  m.queue_count
FROM queued q
CROSS JOIN metrics m
WHERE m.queue_count >= {{$json.maxBatchSize}}
ORDER BY q.created_at ASC
LIMIT GREATEST({{$json.maxBatchSize}}, 100);
